note: The niche corpus boundary. docs/niche_boundary.md is the method, ops/niche_boundary.py re-derives this file from the extraction cache, and src/corpus_niche.Boundary is the predicate. Edit HERE, never in code.
core_rationale: The six CPC subclasses this corpus already holds at 100.0% of patents-public-data (measured 2026-08-22). All eight SEED_CPC subgroups sit inside them, their seed-parent main groups carry evidence density 0.115 to 1.222, and no main group outside them exceeds 0.069. Four characters, the SAME unit as a shard domain in retrieval.shard_router, so every niche family routes to exactly one shard.
adjacent_rationale: CPC MAIN groups, not subclasses. Selected by rule: evidence = (publications among the 80,308 SEED_CPC publications carrying the group) + (distinct examiner-cited documents from that field carrying it); admitted when evidence >= min_support AND evidence/world_publications >= min_density. Y section and 2000-series indexing codes are excluded from the boundary and kept in the record. A main group and not a subclass because a subclass costs 10x to 40x more publications for the same evidence: F04F5 is 22,344 world publications against B65B's 520,361.
closure_rationale: A CPC boundary reaches 28.5% of what examiners in this field cite; 35.9% of that art carries no classification at all and 35.5% is classified somewhere a defensible CPC rule cannot follow. The citation closure is the mechanism that reaches it. Restricted to X and Y relevance codes because the unrestricted examiner closure takes the niche to 94.6% of the corpus, which is not a niche: measured 2026-08-22, X/Y adds 505,088 families and all examiner categories adds 2,041,704.
